executor_profile.justification: Bounded, mechanical addition to an existing, well-understood module (sdlc_manager.py's prepare/create path) consuming metrics functions (metrics_cycle_time, board_wip) that already exist and are already tested. Not an architectural judgment call on the order of the runtime concurrency governor (pf-adaptive-admission-governor), which justifies opus/high plus a second opinion because a wrong control-loop decision there fails silently as starvation or oscillation. A held-vs-admit threshold check with an audit record is deterministic and unit-testable without an external second opinion.
